title: Aromatic Spicy Thai Duck Tom Yum
description: A salty, creamy, and kid-friendly Thai dish featuring duck confit leg, this tom yum is a twist on the classic recipe, made keto-friendly and served in a cazuela.
instructions: Heat the coconut milk in a large cazuela over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the tom yum paste and stir until it is fully incorporated and fragrant.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, lemon grass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves to the cazuela and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the shredded duck confit leg to the cazuela and stir to combine.
Add the sliced mushrooms and chilies to the cazuela and stir to combine.
Simmer the tom yum for an additional 5 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the duck is heated through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tom yum hot, garnished with additional kaffir lime leaves and chilies if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
